title: Event Sponsorship Intake Form
subtitle: Event Sponsorship workflow to capture a received request or item, assess evidence, route a decision, manage exceptions, and close the intake.
description: An original event sponsorship intake form for nonprofit operators to preserve sponsor relationship identity, workflow evidence, decisions, exceptions, qualified review, and accountable closeout.
use_case: Use when a nonprofit team must manage a sponsor relationship through the intake workflow while keeping consent, privacy, authority, evidence, escalation, and handoff visible.

sections.title: Event Sponsorship intake routing
sections.guidance: Identify the record, source, priority, subject, and accountable owner.

blocks.label: Intake identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Use this record ID on attachments, corrections, and follow-up.

blocks.label: Event Sponsorship identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identities used by the controlling program or partner record.

sections.title: Event Sponsorship intake need, scope, and source
sections.guidance: Capture the received facts without making unsupported eligibility or acceptance decisions.

blocks.label: Event Sponsorship readiness and record controls
blocks.guidance: Confirm facts and routes; do not infer approval from a checked item.
items: Sponsor identity, contact, event, and package are confirmed
Cash and in-kind components are separated and documented
Benefits, deliverables, limits, and fulfillment dates are explicit
Brand assets, approvals, placement, and usage period are recorded
Tickets, hospitality, recognition, or speaking access are quantified
Restricted categories, exclusivity, conflicts, or ethics concerns are routed
Payment or delivery evidence links to the sponsorship record
Substitutions and unmet benefits require documented approval

blocks.label: Intake workflow controls
blocks.guidance: Mark each applicable control and route any unmet condition.
items: Intake source, date, requested outcome, and accountable owner are clear
Facts supplied by the requester are distinguished from verified evidence
Required documents and missing information are itemized
Urgency, privacy, consent, and restricted-record needs are routed
Eligibility or acceptance is not inferred from intake completion
Decision owner, response target, and handoff destination are assigned

sections.title: Event Sponsorship intake items and required follow-up
sections.guidance: Preserve repeated items and the evidence needed to reconstruct the record.

blocks.label: Event Sponsorship received needs, evidence, and routing
blocks.guidance: Use one row per distinct item, activity, commitment, event, or service entry.

blocks.label: Received facts, requested outcome, known constraints, missing evidence, and routing rationale
blocks.guidance: Separate direct facts, attributed statements, and unresolved assumptions.

fields.label: Received facts, requested outcome, known constraints, missing evidence, and routing rationale

sections.title: Event Sponsorship evidence and completeness review
sections.guidance: Link the subject-specific evidence, record boundaries, and missing information.

blocks.label: Event Sponsorship evidence review
blocks.guidance: Retain source references and correction history in the approved record.
items: Benefits, deliverables, limits, and fulfillment dates are explicit
Brand assets, approvals, placement, and usage period are recorded
Tickets, hospitality, recognition, or speaking access are quantified
Restricted categories, exclusivity, conflicts, or ethics concerns are routed
Payment or delivery evidence links to the sponsorship record
Substitutions and unmet benefits require documented approval
Event cancellation, postponement, refund, or credit terms are routed
Post-event proof and sponsor acceptance have accountable owners

sections.title: Event Sponsorship intake decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Document the status, evidence basis, conditions, and accountable decision owner.

blocks.label: Decision and authorization basis
items: Received scope and supporting evidence were reviewed
Missing, conflicting, or sensitive information remains visible
Policy, capacity, eligibility, and authority questions were routed
Decision rationale, conditions, and communication route are recorded
The next accountable owner and due point are assigned

blocks.label: Decision rationale, conditions, limits, and next action

fields.label: Decision rationale, conditions, limits, and next action

sections.title: Event Sponsorship exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Keep incomplete, sensitive, unsafe, disputed, or unauthorized work visible.

blocks.label: Intake authority and record boundary
blocks.guidance: Intake completion records received facts; it does not establish eligibility, acceptance, professional conclusions, or entitlement. This worksheet does not create a sponsorship agreement, certify tax treatment, or authorize brand use. Apply current event, ethics, finance, privacy, and contract-review procedures. Route binding terms and unresolved sponsor benefits to authorized reviewers before fulfillment. Hold unresolved work and route it to the qualified owner under applicable policy.

blocks.label: Event Sponsorship exception triggers
blocks.guidance: Mark each applicable trigger and explain uncertain scope below.
items: Sponsor identity, package, benefit, value, or due date is unclear
Brand, exclusivity, ethics, conflict, or restricted-category review is open
Payment, in-kind delivery, asset, ticket, or hospitality obligation is late
Venue, production, accessibility, or technical constraint affects fulfillment
Event change requires benefit substitution, credit, refund, or new approval
Agreement, tax, acknowledgment, or authority question needs qualified review

blocks.label: Event Sponsorship unresolved-item register
blocks.guidance: Do not close a row until disposition and accountable ownership are explicit.

blocks.label: Escalation facts, notifications, restrictions, and qualified-review route

fields.label: Escalation facts, notifications, restrictions, and qualified-review route

sections.title: Event Sponsorship intake closeout and handoff
sections.guidance: Reconcile the final status, transfer open work, and preserve accountable acceptance.

blocks.label: Event Sponsorship open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Event Sponsorship handoff confirmations
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.
items: Intake disposition and rationale were communicated
Received evidence and correction history were filed
Referrals and open information requests retain owners
Receiving program or reviewer accepted the handoff
Remaining limitations are visible at closeout
Sponsor, package, consideration, and benefit obligations were reconciled
Brand approvals, placement, tickets, hospitality, and access were documented

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes

fields.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes

blocks.label: Accountable preparation and review
blocks.guidance: Record accountable preparation and qualified review.
